mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 53 degrees with overcast skies at Reddan Soccer Park and a waxing crescent moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The City of Verona has updated its list of polling locations with two new sites for the upcoming election. Residents should visit the My Vote Wisconsin website to check their specific ward and polling place, as your designated location may have changed. All polls are open from 7:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. on election day.

We have a full schedule of local happenings. Today, you can participate in Yoga at Insight Wellness, enjoy ART House 360, or test your knowledge at Hop Haus Trivia. Looking ahead, we have live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee tomorrow, followed by the Dane County Farmers' Market this Saturday.

In a noteworthy call from October 7, officers responded to a collision on Basswood Avenue where a juvenile on an electric motorcycle attempted to pass a vehicle that was turning, resulting in minor injuries.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Crazy for Cookie Dough. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and satisfy your sweet tooth.
